name: txg-mcp
description: MCP server for accessing TXG CLI functionality through LLMs
long_description: The TXG MCP Server provides a secure interface to TXG (10x Genomics) CLI tools, enabling LLMs to interact with genomics analysis workflows. This extension allows you to manage projects, run Cell Ranger analyses, upload/download files, and more through natural language commands.

user_config.name: txg_executable
user_config.description: Path to the TXG CLI executable

user_config.name: command_timeout
user_config.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) to wait for a command to complete

tools.name: create_cellranger_multi_analysis
tools.description: Creates a new Cell Ranger 'multi' analysis

tools.name: create_cellranger_count_analysis
tools.description: Creates a new Cell Ranger 'count' analysis

tools.name: create_cellranger_aggr_analysis
tools.description: Creates a new Cell Ranger 'aggr' analysis to aggregate multiple runs

tools.name: list_analyses
tools.description: Lists all analyses in a specific project

tools.name: get_analysis_details
tools.description: Shows details about a single analysis

tools.name: list_analysis_files
tools.description: Lists all files within a single analysis

tools.name: download_analysis_files
tools.description: Downloads all files from an analysis

tools.name: list_annotation_models
tools.description: Lists available cell annotation models

tools.name: list_fastqs
tools.description: Lists FASTQ files for a given project

tools.name: upload_fastqs
tools.description: Uploads FASTQ files to a project

tools.name: list_project_files
tools.description: Lists general files for a given project

tools.name: upload_project_file
tools.description: Uploads a local file to a project

tools.name: download_project_file
tools.description: Downloads a specific file from a project

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Lists all available projects

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Creates a new project

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Updates project details

tools.name: list_references
tools.description: Lists all custom references

tools.name: get_reference
tools.description: Shows details for a specific custom reference

tools.name: update_reference
tools.description: Updates custom reference details

tools.name: upload_reference
tools.description: Uploads a custom reference
